prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover show scuffing, a cracked corner of the cover, and a dented fender edge consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. Parts of the lower rear door show paint transfer that may or may not stem from this event, so I have noted those areas for closer review at teardown. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the file. The proposed plan replaces the bumper cover, refinishes the quarter panel, and repairs the fender edge. The labor hours requested fit the scope of the damage described, and the supplied invoices show no repeated charges.
